description: Flat, static, machine-facing routing surface for Mandala Oracle interactions. Cross-linked JSONL indexes over conversations, readings, casts (transforms), and source texts.

cross_references.readings -> source_text_id, cast_transfo: cast_transform_ids derived by scanning casts for matching reading_axn
cross_references.casts -> reading_axn, source_text_id, tr: native fields in the transform record
